items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: Bill Jones you may know, played the piano

ctx.x: That’s when he was with the Paul Whiteman band, and he had his 75th birthday and that’s the party he had, and this is the program. And Bill Jones you may know, played the piano, and I know Challis went to Bucknell University and this is the speech he made there too, it’s remarkable. I wouldn’t want to lose that, but...
I wonder if Spiegle Wilcox is in this picture.
